# BNR Metric Specification Register

## Document control

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Document | BNR Metric Specification Register |
| Short name | Metric register |
| Version | Version 1 |
| Status | Development version; not yet approved for routine production |
| Date | 15 September 2026 |
| Owner | BNR Lead and BNR Analyst |
| Companion document | [BNR Information Hub Statistical Analysis Plan](sap.qmd) |

## Purpose

This register defines the routine public metrics created by the current BNR CVD event and mortality workflows. It gives each metric a stable identifier and states exactly what it measures.

Version 1 contains six metric families. Event type, sex, period, age group, case definition and source scope are dimensions within those metrics; they are not separate metrics unless the analytical definition changes.

The [Statistical Analysis Plan](sap.qmd) gives the shared population, classification, DCO, statistical, missing-data and disclosure-control rules. Both documents must be read together.

## Version 1 metric set

| Metric ID | Metric | Routine public result |
|---|---|---|
| `CVD-BURDEN-001` | CVD event count | Hospital-recorded counts and annual estimated national counts including DCO events |
| `CVD-BURDEN-002` | CVD event distribution | Annual hospital-recorded event-type, sex and broad-age percentages |
| `CVD-INCIDENCE-001` | CVD event incidence rate | Annual crude and age-standardised hospital-recorded and hospital-plus-DCO rates |
| `MORT-BURDEN-001` | CVD mortality count | Monthly, quarterly and annual death counts under the Primary and Inclusive definitions |
| `MORT-BURDEN-002` | CVD mortality distribution | Annual event-type, sex and broad-age percentages under both definitions |
| `MORT-RATE-001` | CVD mortality rate | Annual crude and age-standardised mortality rates under both definitions |

All six metrics are approved for the handover version of the BNR Info-Hub (version 1.0).

## Shared fields and terms

Routine metric files identify, as applicable:

- metric ID and metric name;
- source-release identity;
- reporting year, quarter or month;
- event or cause type;
- sex and age group;
- mortality case definition;
- source or ascertainment scope;
- statistic and unit;
- value, numerator and denominator;
- confidence limits or DCO linkage bounds where relevant;
- comparison-period information; and
- disclosure and publication status.

Common labels mean:

| Term | Meaning |
|---|----|
| All CVD | The approved combined CVD category, with each eligible event or death counted once in the relevant definition. |
| Heart | Heart attack in the hospital event series; the broader approved Heart cause category in the mortality series. |
| Stroke | The approved stroke event or mortality category. |
| Primary | Mortality evidence classified Clear or Likely. |
| Inclusive | Mortality evidence classified Clear, Likely or Possible. It contains the Primary definition. |
| Hospital only | Directly observed, eligible hospital-recorded events. |
| Additional DCO | Estimated eligible events at death that are not represented by a qualifying hospital event in the preceding 0–27 days. |
| Hospital plus DCO | Hospital-recorded events plus the estimated additional DCO events. |

## CVD event metrics

### CVD-BURDEN-001: CVD event count

**Plain-language definition.** The number of eligible CVD events in a reporting period. The metric reports the hospital-recorded series and, for completed years, the estimated additional-DCO and hospital-plus-DCO series.

$$
\text{Hospital-recorded event count}
=
\sum_{i=1}^{n} I_i
$$

Here, \(I_i=1\) when event \(i\) meets the eligibility rules and \(I_i=0\) when it does not.

For the estimated national count:

$$
\text{Hospital-plus-DCO count}
=
\text{hospital-recorded count}
+
\text{estimated additional-DCO count}
$$

| Field | Specification |
|---|---|
| Metric ID | `CVD-BURDEN-001` |
| Status | Development |
| Metric type | Count |
| Unit | Event |
| Hospital numerator | Eligible hospital-recorded events among Barbados residents. Repeated records for one event are not counted again; distinct events for one person must be at least 28 days apart. |
| DCO numerator | Additional DCO events created or estimated from eligible mortality candidates using the deterministic linkage and aggregate unresolved-candidate method in the SAP. |
| Denominator | Not applicable |
| Event types | All CVD, Heart and Stroke. In the hospital series, Heart means the approved heart-attack definition. |
| Monthly public rows | Hospital only: All CVD, all sexes, all ages. |
| Quarterly public rows | Hospital only: All CVD, Heart and Stroke by all sexes, female and male; all ages. Each row has a same-quarter previous-five-year mean when sufficient history exists. |
| Annual public rows | Hospital only: All CVD, Heart and Stroke by all sexes, female and male; all ages. All CVD/all-sex rows are also produced for under 70 and 70 years and over. Each row has a previous-five-year mean when sufficient history exists. |
| Annual DCO rows | Additional DCO and hospital plus DCO: All CVD, Heart and Stroke by all sexes, female and male, for Primary and Inclusive mortality evidence; all ages only. |
| Uncertainty | No statistical confidence interval for counts. DCO rows carry separate linkage/ascertainment lower, central and upper values. Aggregate DCO values may be fractional. |
| Missing data | Missing age does not remove an otherwise eligible event from an all-age count, but the event cannot enter an age-specific row. Essential missing or invalid eligibility fields cause exclusion or quarantine. |
| Disclosure | Apply `bnr_sdc_v1` to the count and all connected public statistics. |
| Implementation | `scripts/stata/metrics/cvd/bnr_step4_cvd_burden.do` and the CVD Step 4 DCO linkage workflow |

### CVD-BURDEN-002: CVD event distribution

**Plain-language definition.** The percentage distribution of eligible hospital-recorded CVD events across event type, sex or broad age group in a completed year.

$$
\text{Percentage}=\frac{\text{eligible events in the category}}{\text{eligible events in the parent group}}\times100
$$

| Field | Specification |
|---|---|
| Metric ID | `CVD-BURDEN-002` |
| Status | Development |
| Metric type | Percentage distribution |
| Unit | Event |
| Event-type distribution | Heart and Stroke counts as percentages of the relevant All CVD parent count. |
| Sex distribution | Female and male counts as percentages of the relevant event-type parent count. |
| Broad-age distribution | Under 70 and 70 years and over as percentages of All CVD events with known eligible age. |
| Period | Completed calendar year |
| Source scope | Hospital only |
| Confidence interval | Not routinely produced |
| Missing data | Records with missing age are excluded from both the numerator and denominator of the broad-age distribution. They may remain in the all-age event count. |
| Disclosure | Protect the numerator, parent count and percentage together under `bnr_sdc_v1`. |
| Implementation | `scripts/stata/metrics/cvd/bnr_step4_cvd_burden.do` |

### CVD-INCIDENCE-001: CVD event incidence rate

**Plain-language definition.** The annual number of eligible CVD events per 100,000 Barbados residents. Hospital-recorded and estimated hospital-plus-DCO rates are two source scopes of the same metric.

Crude rate:

$$
\text{Rate per 100,000}=\frac{\text{eligible events}}{\text{matching resident population}}\times100,000
$$

Directly age-standardised rate:

$$
\text{Age-standardised rate}=\sum_{a=1}^{21}w_ar_a
$$

| Field | Specification |
|---|---|
| Metric ID | `CVD-INCIDENCE-001` |
| Status | Development |
| Metric type | Crude rate and directly age-standardised rate |
| Units | Events per 100,000 population |
| Numerator scopes | Hospital only; hospital plus DCO central estimate |
| Denominator | UN World Population Prospects 2024 estimate for Barbados, matched by year, sex and five-year age group |
| Standard population | WHO World Standard Population 2000–2025 |
| Age bands | 21 five-year groups: 0–4 through 95–99, then 100 years and over |
| Event types | All CVD, Heart and Stroke |
| Sex | All sexes, female and male |
| Period | Completed calendar year |
| Hospital crude interval | Exact Poisson (Garwood) 95% confidence interval |
| Hospital age-standardised interval | Fay–Feuer gamma 95% confidence interval |
| Hospital-plus-DCO crude interval | Conditional gamma 95% confidence interval around the central aggregate DCO estimate |
| Hospital-plus-DCO age-standardised interval | Conditional Fay–Feuer gamma 95% confidence interval around the central age-specific pseudo-counts |
| DCO bounds | Linkage/ascertainment lower, central and upper rates are retained separately from statistical confidence limits. |
| Missing data | Events without an eligible age cannot contribute to an age-specific or age-standardised rate. Missing population joins stop the rate calculation. |
| Disclosure | Protect the underlying count, rate, confidence limits and DCO bounds together under `bnr_sdc_v1`. |
| Implementation | `scripts/stata/metrics/cvd/bnr_cvd_run_incidence_rate_estimation.do` and `scripts/stata/metrics/cvd/bnr_cvd_construct_incidence_rates_core.do` |

The hospital-only rate is a measure of serious events recognised through the hospital-based registry; it is not described as complete national ascertainment. The hospital-plus-DCO rate has broader estimated coverage but adds mortality-classification and linkage uncertainty.

## CVD mortality metrics

### MORT-BURDEN-001: CVD mortality count

**Plain-language definition.** The number of registered deaths that meet the BNR Primary or Inclusive CVD mortality definition in a reporting period.

$$
\text{CVD mortality count}
=
\sum_{i=1}^{n} D_i
$$

Here, \(D_i=1\) when death \(i\) meets the selected Primary or Inclusive definition and the other eligibility rules, and \(D_i=0\) when it does not. Primary and Inclusive counts are calculated separately.

| Field | Specification |
|---|----|
| Metric ID | `MORT-BURDEN-001` |
| Status | Development |
| Metric type | Count |
| Unit | Death |
| Numerator | Deaths classified Clear or Likely for the Primary definition; deaths classified Clear, Likely or Possible for the Inclusive definition. |
| Denominator | Not applicable |
| Event types | All CVD, Heart and Stroke, based on the resolved mortality classification. |
| Monthly public rows | All CVD, all sexes, all ages, for Primary and Inclusive definitions. |
| Quarterly public rows | All CVD, Heart and Stroke by all sexes, female and male; all ages; for both definitions. Each row has a same-quarter previous-five-year mean when sufficient history exists. |
| Annual public rows | All CVD, Heart and Stroke by all sexes, female and male; all ages; for both definitions. All CVD/all-sex rows are also produced for under 70 and 70 years and over. Each row has a previous-five-year mean when sufficient history exists. |
| Uncertainty | No statistical confidence interval for counts. Primary and Inclusive are classification-sensitivity definitions, not confidence limits. |
| Missing data | A valid death date and known female or male sex are required. Missing age does not remove an otherwise eligible death from an all-age count, but the death cannot enter an age-specific row. Records that cannot be safely classified are handled through the classification and review rules. |
| Disclosure | Apply `bnr_sdc_v1` to the count and all connected public statistics. |
| Implementation | `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s3_calc.do` |

### MORT-BURDEN-002: CVD mortality distribution

**Plain-language definition.** The percentage distribution of eligible CVD deaths across cause type, sex or broad age group in a completed year, shown separately for the Primary and Inclusive definitions.

$$
\text{Percentage}=\frac{\text{eligible deaths in the category}}{\text{eligible deaths in the parent group}}\times100
$$

| Field | Specification |
|---|----|
| Metric ID | `MORT-BURDEN-002` |
| Status | Development |
| Metric type | Percentage distribution |
| Unit | Death |
| Cause distribution | Heart and Stroke deaths as percentages of the relevant All CVD parent count. |
| Sex distribution | Female and male deaths as percentages of the relevant cause parent count. |
| Broad-age distribution | Under 70 and 70 years and over as percentages of All CVD deaths with known eligible age. |
| Case definitions | Primary and Inclusive, reported separately |
| Period | Completed calendar year |
| Confidence interval | Not routinely produced |
| Missing data | A valid death date and known female or male sex are required. Deaths with missing age are excluded from both the numerator and denominator of the broad-age distribution. They may remain in the all-age mortality count. |
| Disclosure | Protect the numerator, parent count and percentage together under `bnr_sdc_v1`. |
| Implementation | `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s3_calc.do` |

### MORT-RATE-001: CVD mortality rate

**Plain-language definition.** The annual number of eligible CVD deaths per 100,000 Barbados residents, shown separately under the Primary and Inclusive mortality definitions.

The crude mortality rate is:

$$
\text{Crude mortality rate per 100,000}
=
\frac{\text{eligible CVD deaths}}
{\text{matching Barbados resident population}}
\times 100,000
$$

The directly age-standardised mortality rate is:

$$
\text{Age-standardised mortality rate}
=
\sum_{a=1}^{21} w_a r_a
$$

Here, \(r_a\) is the mortality rate for age group \(a\), and \(w_a\) is that age group's weight in the WHO World Standard Population 2000–2025. Rates are calculated separately for the Primary and Inclusive mortality definitions.

| Field | Specification |
|---|----|
| Metric ID | `MORT-RATE-001` |
| Status | Development |
| Metric type | Crude rate and directly age-standardised rate |
| Units | Deaths per 100,000 population |
| Numerator | Eligible deaths under the selected Primary or Inclusive definition |
| Denominator | UN World Population Prospects 2024 estimate for Barbados, matched by year, sex and five-year age group |
| Standard population | WHO World Standard Population 2000–2025 |
| Age bands | 21 five-year groups: 0–4 through 95–99, then 100 years and over |
| Event types | All CVD, Heart and Stroke |
| Sex | All sexes, female and male |
| Case definitions | Primary and Inclusive |
| Period | Completed calendar year |
| Crude interval | Exact Poisson (Garwood) 95% confidence interval |
| Age-standardised interval | Fay–Feuer gamma 95% confidence interval |
| Missing data | A valid death date and known female or male sex are required. Deaths without an eligible age cannot contribute to an age-specific or age-standardised rate. Missing population joins stop the rate calculation. |
| Disclosure | If the underlying annual count is protected, the matching crude and age-standardised rates and confidence limits are also unavailable. Apply `bnr_sdc_v1`. |
| Implementation | `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_construct_rates.do` |

## Supporting analytical assets

The following are controlled supporting outputs, not additional metric IDs:

| Asset | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Previous-five-year mean | Compares an annual value with the preceding five completed years, or a quarterly value with the same quarter in the preceding five years. It is unavailable until five prior values exist. |
| Fixed monthly reference | Gives dashboards an approved month-specific reference, including fixed 2015–2019 values where used. |
| DCO linkage summary and bounds | Records resolved and unresolved linkage evidence and the lower, central and upper ascertainment estimates used for annual national event results. Detailed worklists remain private. |
| Release receipt, manifest and approval record | Identifies the source, code, settings and exact payload used for review and publication. |

## Change control

A routine metric may be added, retired or materially changed only when the BNR records:

- the reason and intended use;
- the exact population, numerator, denominator and dimensions;
- the statistical and disclosure methods;
- the responsible implementation and tests;
- validation against the previous method where relevant;
- the effect on earlier releases and public interpretation; and
- approval by the BNR Lead or BNR Analyst.

Update this register, the SAP, code, tests and public methods explanation together. Preserve the previous definition in version history rather than silently overwriting the record of use.
